data.one_liner: Changes the case of input text to various conventions.
data.what_it_does: It transforms strings between different casing formats like camelCase, snake_case, PascalCase, and constantCase. Both class-based and String extension APIs are supported.
use_when: You need to format strings into snake_case, camelCase, or other standard conventions.
You are transforming user input or API responses into consistent naming styles.
avoid_when: You need complex internationalization or localization tools.
strengths: Supports a wide variety of case conventions.
weaknesses: Limited scope restricted strictly to string casing transformations.
